title: Along one ray with orientation ±e the action is a ray integral with a locally integrable, a.e. integer density (parent steps 1, 4–7)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let R = (M, θ, ξ) be a 1-dimensional integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ 1), let e ∈ ℝ^P with |e| = 1, and suppose that for H¹-a.e. x ∈ M ∩ ray(e) (H¹ = μHE[1], ray(e) := {te : t > 0}) the orientation satisfies ξ(x) = ev_e or ξ(x) = −ev_e, where ev_e is the 1-vector α ↦ α(e) (ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply at fun _ => e). Then there is g : ℝ → ℝ that is locally integrable on (0, ∞), integer valued at almost every t > 0, and such that for every test 1-form ω ∈ 𝒟¹(ℝ^P): ∫_{M ∩ ray(e)} θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dH¹(x) = ∫_{(0,∞)} g(t)·ω(te)(e) dt.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (e : Euclid P), ‖e‖ = 1 → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[1] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict (R.carrier ∩ (fun t : ℝ => t • e) '' Ioi 0)), R.orient x = ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℝ (Euclid P) ℝ (fun _ : Fin 1 => e) ∨ R.orient x = -ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℝ (Euclid P) ℝ (fun _ : Fin 1 => e)) → ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ, LocallyIntegrableOn g (Ioi 0) ∧ (∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))), ∃ k : ℤ, g t = k) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, ∫ x in R.carrier ∩ (fun t : ℝ => t • e) '' Ioi 0, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) x) ∂μHE[1] = ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), g t * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) (t • e) (fun _ => e)
